name: Tomb Raider
body:
You are adept at exploring dangerous ruins and dungeons.

Prerequisite: Trapmaker class feature, favored terrain (subterranean) class feature.

Benefit: Add your levels of cryptic and ranger together for the purposes of your trapfinding and favored terrain class features. In addition, you can add your favored terrain (subterranean) bonus to Disable Device checks when in a subterranean terrain.
